schemaVersion.description: Contract version. The game reads the versions in config feeds[feed].versions. Additive fields do not bump it; renames, unit changes and removals do.

generatedAt.description: When the backend wrote the file.

validUntil.description: After this a live feed counts as stale: in live mode its values ease to neutral. Required on live feeds in live data; optional on static tables.

source.description: "sample", or the backend’s own label (e.g. "db:weather/v2"). Audit only; never shown.

sample.description: True for hand-made data. Live mode refuses a file marked sample unless it is a preset table (config feeds[f].defaultInLive) (decision 4).

bundleRevision.description: The publication this file belongs to; must equal the manifest’s.

id.description: Stable key. Fades, audio voices, dissolve seeds and per-device memory key on it. Unique within the feed.

revision.description: Whole number that rises whenever the row changes (diffing, cache-busting, precedence ties).

sample.description: True for hand-made data. Must be true in every sample file; must be false in live data.

method.description: How the preset was chosen upstream, e.g. "weaviate-hybrid+rules".

confidence01.description: A calibrated classification confidence, 0–1. Only when calibrated: Weaviate distances and hybrid scores rank candidates and are not probabilities, so they stay upstream (R14). Below minConfidence01 (config) the game uses the category default.

classification.description: How the preset ids in this record were chosen upstream.

tags.description: Free labels from the backend; the game ignores them.

rightsRef.description: Rights note for any recorded sound or authored asset the record names (the owner's own recordings only).

trigger.description: The moment it plays (fed by the same triggers as the sounds).

patternMs.description: Vibration pattern, milliseconds on, off, on … (Android; the store app’s native driver); a 0 on-time is a slot with no phone pulse (gamepad only).

everyOn.description: True: the rumble plays at the start of every on-time of patternMs (a two-tick cue rumbles twice); absent or false: once.

minGapSec.description: Never repeats sooner than this, seconds.

falloffMetres.description: Strength falls to 0 over this distance (firework, thunder). Absent = full.

priority.description: Its place in the calm budget (FEEDBACK_CONFIG.budget): 0 drops first, 1 next, 2 and 3 are never dropped (above keepAbovePriority). Data tunes a cue only within its class: a cue whose default is at or below keepAbovePriority is held at or below it (never promoted out of the budget), and one whose default is above it is held at keepAbovePriority + 1 or more (never demoted into it). Absent: the default for its trigger.

impacts.description: The impact style of each on-time in turn (the last repeats for any further on-time).

notification.description: One UIKit notification in place of the pattern (it has its own shape).

maxImpact.description: Without impacts: the strongest style the strength may pick (a frequent moment never plays HEAVY). Absent: any.

ios.description: The iPhone app: impact styles per on-time, or a notification. Absent: each on-time plays one impact whose style follows strength (PLATFORM_CONFIG.haptics.iosImpact).

records.description: The rows. A row that fails its check is skipped and counted; the rest still load.
